name: claude-mission-control
description: Local web dashboard to supervise Claude Code sessions in near real-time (fleet status, consumption metrics).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "yarn workspace @cmc/server dev" "yarn workspace @cmc/web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @cmc/web build && yarn workspace @cmc/server build
scripts.backup: yarn workspace @cmc/server build && yarn workspace @cmc/server backup
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @cmc/server typecheck && yarn workspace @cmc/web typecheck
